# Disagreement Log — GTH_061

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 61
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 61 | "man" | "sir" | "you" (no title) | Salome's address: *rōme* as title or challenge |
| 2 | 61 | "come up upon my couch" | "reclined on my couch" | "climbed onto my couch" | Action verb for Jesus's posture at table |
| 3 | 61 | "from what is whole" | "from the one who is whole" | "from what is undivided" | *petjek*: abstract wholeness vs. personal source vs. negative form |
| 4 | 61 | attribution unclear | bracketed attribution | explicit attribution | Who speaks "I am your disciple"? |
| 5 | 61 | "when he becomes divided" | "when he is divided" | "when someone is split in two" | Division: process vs. state vs. vivid description |

**Total disagreements: 5**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "man" for *rōme*, "reclined" for posture, "what is whole" for *petjek*, Salome attribution without brackets, and "when someone is divided."
